HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE SWARANA KANTA SHARMA  ORDER % 04.09.2025 CRL.M.A. 26479/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

By way of the instant petition, the petitioners seek quashing of the FIR bearing no. 0025/2023 dated 30.01.2023, registered at Police Station Inderpuri, West Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
4. Issue notice.
The learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of the State.

5. The petitioners and respondent no.2 are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsel and Investigating Officer (IO) concerned from Police Station Inderpuri, West Delhi.
6. Brief facts of the case are that the marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 09.12.2020 according to Hindu rites, customs and ceremonies.
No child was born out of the said wedlock.

It is stated that during the subsistence of their marriage, various differences,
disputes and issues had arisen between the petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 and respondent no.
2 had started residing separately w.e.f. 02.08.2022.
Thereafter, upon a complaint filed by respondent no. 2 before the concerned police station, the present FIR came to be registered against the petitioners.

It is stated that with intervention of the family and friends, the parties have now amicably settled their dispute before the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi vide Settlement Deed dated 18.03.2025.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further stated that both the parties have obtained decree of divorce by way of mutual consent from the concerned Court.

7. On a query made by this Court, respondent no. 2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.

She further states that she has received a sum of Rs.9,00,000/- by way of a demand draft bearing no. 015071 dated 01.09.2025 drawn on HDFC Bank, from the petitioner no.1 in Court today and that she has no objection, if the present FIR is quashed.
8.

In view of the above, since the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings,
rather the same would

It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

9. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 0025/2023 dated 30.01.2023, registered at Police Station Inderpuri,
West Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
10. In view of above, the present petition stands disposed of.
11. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J SEPTEMBER 04, 2025/ns
